mapper.select: SELECT LANG_CODE, LANG_NAME, NATIVE_NAME, FALLBACK_LANG_CODE, DEFAULT_YN FROM TB_LANGUAGE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, LANG_CODE

SELECT M.MESSAGE_CODE, M.MESSAGE_TYPE, M.HTTP_STATUS, M.SEVERITY, L.LANG_CODE, L.MESSAGE_TEXT, M.ARG_COUNT FROM TB_MESSAGE M LEFT JOIN TB_MESSAGE_LANG L ON L.MESSAGE_CODE = M.MESSAGE_CODE AND L.LANG_CODE = #{language} AND L.USE_YN = 'Y' AND L.TRANSLATED_YN = 'Y' WHERE M.MESSAGE_CODE = #{code} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'
